name: PartDefinition
lead: A named part of a stored world (`world: <folder>`) and the generator that writes it. Declared, not run: `citadel generate <pack> --part <name>`, or `/part generate <name>` in build mode, runs it; a changed file runs it again while nobody has edited the part. See "parts" in docs/luau-api.md.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: 1 (whole blocks, the default) or 2 (half blocks), as world.build.
